facts.fact: Orange Liberia's chairman, who is also CEO of the Cable Consortium of Liberia, said its fibre link to Cote d'Ivoire let Liberia keep 100% of its international internet traffic during a four-day ACE cable outage, the link connecting to six other undersea cables via Cote d'Ivoire.
facts.system: ACE cable and Orange Liberia fibre link to Cote d'Ivoire
